description: This file defines a PHP script for managing 'platforms' in the TestLink open source test management system. It includes functions for creating, editing, updating, deleting, and viewing platform entities, handling form inputs, security checks, and rendering templates. The script interacts with database objects and external components like Smarty templates and web editors.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment, session, and obtains necessary objects such as database handler, GUI object, and platform manager.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Extracts and validates request parameters, retrieves related database info, and prepares arguments for further processing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares the GUI variables for creating a new platform.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the GUI with existing platform data for editing.

methods.name: do_create
methods.description: Performs database operations to create a new platform entry.

methods.name: do_update
methods.description: Updates an existing platform entry in the database.

methods.name: do_delete
methods.description: Deletes a platform entry from the database.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a localized error message based on error code.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI object with platform and user data.

methods.name: checkPageAccess
methods.description: Performs security check to verify user permissions for platform management.
